programme.title: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science | Harvard SEAS
programme.degree: Bachelor of Arts (A.B.) in Computer Science; a concentration of Harvard College
programme.how_found: seas.harvard.edu -> Computer Science -> Undergraduate program; admissions facts from college.harvard.edu (university-wide undergraduate admissions, owner ruling for US universities).
programme.notes: All prospective undergraduates apply to Harvard College and declare the concentration later; english, deadline, tuition and aid are scoped to Harvard College.

english.quote: Although you are not required to take an English proficiency exam (such as the TOEFL, IELTS, etc.), you may submit scores if you wish to do so.
english.notes: No English test minimum: first-year applicants may submit scores optionally. TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo cannot replace the SAT/ACT requirement.

gpa.notes: No minimum GPA or grade threshold published; holistic review. SAT or ACT required (exceptions listed on the application-requirements page), no minimum score stated.

deadline.quote: Your portions of the application are due by January 1 at 11:59pm (your local time)
deadline.notes: Regular Decision; the same timetable for all applicants regardless of citizenship ("all applicants follow the same procedures and timetables"). The year is not printed on the page; for fall 2027 entry this is 1 January 2027. Restrictive Early Action: November 1.

tuition.notes: Harvard College 2026-2027: tuition $62,226, fees $6,216, housing $14,250, food $8,942. 2027-2028 not yet published. The cost-of-attendance URL redirects to How Aid Works.

value.name: Harvard College need-based financial aid (scholarship grants)

scholarship_exists.quote: This may include scholarship funds and student employment, as well as any scholarships you’ve earned from outside sources.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based only, need-blind admission; meets full demonstrated need; families with income below $100,000 expected parent contribution zero. Not merit-based. Classification: NEED_BASED_POSSIBLE.

scholarship_international.quote: International students are eligible for exactly the same aid as American students.
scholarship_international.notes: Also on the international applicants page: "Our admissions and financial aid processes are the same for all applicants - regardless of nationality or citizenship."
